region.text: the separatist-held parts of Luhansk Oblast

ledger.note: 27 April 2014: pro-Russian activists proclaim the Luhansk People's Republic at a gathering outside the regional administration building. The SBU building in Luhansk was stormed on 6 April; a referendum was held on 11 May 2014 (96.2% for self-rule, no international observers) and Bolotov declared the republic independent afterwards.

April 2014: Ukraine's Anti-Terrorist Operation. The ATO began on 15 April 2014 (the war page; the LPR page says Ukrainian forces still held about 50% of the oblast on 10 May 2014); the Luhansk front has no day on the pages.

12 February 2015: Minsk II. 'On 12 February 2015, DPR and LPR leaders Alexander Zakharchenko and Igor Plotnitsky signed the Minsk II agreement.' The front then stayed static until 2022 (War in Donbas page).
24 February 2022: the full-scale invasion. Russia recognised the LPR and the DPR on 21 February 2022 (the Luhansk page) and invaded three days later (the Donbas page).

region.text: Sievierodonetsk and the Lysychansk area on the Siverskyi Donets

ledger.note: 25 June 2022: Sievierodonetsk falls. 'On 25 June 2022, Sievierodonetsk was fully occupied by Russian and separatist forces.'
3 July 2022: Lysychansk falls and all of Luhansk Oblast is held. Lysychansk fell on 3 July, which 'brought all of Luhansk Oblast under the control of Russian and separatist forces'.
30 September 2022: the republic ends in annexation; the fighting continues as Russia against Ukraine elsewhere.
30 September 2022: Russia annexes the LPR. 'Putin announced and signed the annexation of four regions,' including the LPR, after Russia recognised it on 21 February 2022.

wars.name: War in Donbas
wars.outcome: The separatists held the Luhansk area behind a static line from the 2015 Minsk II agreement until the 2022 invasion, when Russian and LPR forces took Sievierodonetsk (25 June) and Lysychansk (3 July) and held the whole oblast.
wars.note: The Luhansk page says the full Luhansk Oblast was under pro-Russian control for about two months before Ukraine's counterattacks; those and the later front changes are outside this dossier (it ends in September 2022).

certainty.note: A line of contact, static from 2015 to February 2022; the pages give no coordinates.

notes: A separatist state Cliopatria lacks. Type rebel. The pages give no area or line of contact; the 2014-2021 shape is a reading and the Ukrainian-held 50% of the oblast in May 2014 is the page's only figure. The page is silent on the 12 May 2014 sovereignty declaration and on the Russian-held lands of 2014-2022 beyond the LPR. Heads' terms are the page's. Gazetteer: Natural Earth names the oblast "Luhans'k".
